text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Listen, listen, Sky! When I moved the rod 
just like you taught me the other day, I 
caught a huge fish!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really? You're so handy as always, 
Rickey.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Nope, it's just that you're such a great 
teacher, Sky! Oh, right! Next time, teach 
me how to find nice nap spots too!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind, but... wouldn't Rickey be 
better at finding that sort of thing? You 
know, with that Environmental Feng Shui... 
stuff?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Rather than places I find through 
databases, the spots Sky wanders into on 
pure intuition always end up being so much 
better!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'd love for you to teach me the trick to 
that!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
... Rickey, you're always showering me 
with compliments.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Really? I'm just saying what's on my mind, 
you know?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, Sky and the things Sky does just 
naturally catch my eye. Ahaha, maybe I'm a 
Sky fan!
